verdict.rationale: The evidence shows SigNoz publishing its own MCP server and Agent Skills so external AI agents can query it. That is the server role. Nothing shows SigNoz acting as an MCP client that connects to third-party MCP servers and uses their tools. An observability platform could plausibly ship such client-side support, so the axis applies, and the absence of evidence makes this none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
